purpose: Teach: 前掲/ケ月/バラエティー/実費/従前/学士/専従/枠内

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 資料の前掲の章を参照しましょう
lines.en: Let's refer to the chapter mentioned in the document.
lines.style: Crisp, efficient. Direct eye contact. Speaking at a steady clip without hurrying. No room for questions — moving the meeting forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。研修は二ケ月の集中型で行います
lines.en: Yes. We'll run the training as a two-month intensive program.
lines.style: Attentive, responsive. Slight lean forward. Taking notes mentally. Voice steady and clear — confirming he's understood and is ready to move ahead.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お客様向けにバラエティーに富んだ商品を展開しましょう
lines.en: Let's develop a product line with plenty of variety for our customers.
lines.style: Forward-thinking, measured. Speaking with quiet authority. A pause before 'variety' — she's thought this through. Expecting agreement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。実費精算の規程を見直しました
lines.en: Yes. I've reviewed the expense settlement guidelines.
lines.style: Factual, thorough. Slight emphasis on 'reviewed' — showing initiative. Quick, professional. No elaboration needed.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 従前の取引条件を尊重しましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we respect the previous terms of our relationships.
lines.style: Measured and thoughtful. Gentle but firm conviction. Speaking as though this matters more than the other points. A slight slowdown on 'respect.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人の学士論文を採用判断の参考にします
lines.en: Yes. We'll use new hires' bachelor's theses as a reference in hiring decisions.
lines.style: Confirming with a note of care. Not defensive. Practical, straightforward. Clear delivery — this is noted and will be acted on.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 専従のサポート担当を置きましょう
lines.en: Let's assign a dedicated support person.
lines.style: Deliberate and clear. Slight emphasis on 'dedicated' — this is important. Speaking with quiet confidence. Room for buy-in, not demand.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経費は枠内で管理します
lines.en: Yes. I'll keep expenses within budget.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Calm, assured. A slight slowdown at the end — closing the conversation, not rushing off. Small nod implied in the voice.
